DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Magpylib computes static magnetic fields of magnets, currents and other
sources from analytical expressions, in vectorized form, and computes the
forces and torques between them. Sources and sensors can be positioned,
moved and rotated along paths, grouped into collections, and displayed with
Matplotlib, Plotly or PyVista.
about.summary: Python package for computation of magnetic fields of magnets, currents and moments.

name: magpylib
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "magpylib" %}
{% set version = "6.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 16a7b11c82dc76d156aa72bbbe3927590cf097dc6a052abb5530d5ee0e81d2e6

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - matplotlib-base >=3.6
    - numpy >=1.23
    - scipy >=1.17.1
    - plotly >=5.16
test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
  imports:
    - magpylib
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://github.com/magpylib/magpylib
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python package for computation of magnetic fields of magnets, currents and moments.
  description: |
    Magpylib computes static magnetic fields of magnets, currents and other
    sources from analytical expressions, in vectorized form, and computes the
    forces and torques between them. Sources and sensors can be positioned,
    moved and rotated along paths, grouped into collections, and displayed with
    Matplotlib, Plotly or PyVista.
  doc_url: https://magpylib.readthedocs.io/en/stable/
  dev_url: https://github.com/magpylib/magpylib

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - OrtnerMichael
    - lucasgcb
    - Alexboiboi
